about: Server verdicts for a structured Ping's `data` object, the Idempotency-Key header and a link button label. Written by laravel, read by the cli, sdk and landing tests. Do not edit by hand.
regenerate: cd laravel && WRITE_STRUCTURED_PING_VECTORS=1 php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/StructuredPingVectorsContractTest.php

server.data: POST /api/rooms/{inviteCode}/notifications: StoreNotificationRequest rules() `data` => nullable|array|max:25 (top-level keys), and its after() hook: a non-empty list is refused, then strlen(json_encode($data)) > 8192 is refused. json_encode with default flags: every non-ASCII UTF-16 unit is a six-byte \uXXXX escape and `/` is \/. `serverBytes` is measured on the data the validator received, after TrimStrings and ConvertEmptyStringsToNull, and is null when the server refused the shape before measuring. The same 8192 rule is repeated in StoreHandoffRequest, StoreQuestionRequest, StoreAgentApprovalRequest, WebhookTriggerService and LiveStatusStreamService.
server.idempotencyKey: App\Support\RequestIdempotency::keyFrom: PHP trim() (space, tab, LF, CR, NUL, vertical tab), then 1 to 255 code points by mb_strlen. `trimmed` is the value stored on the row. Anything else is 422 invalid_idempotency_key. The server accepts any bytes; a header cannot carry them all, so clients may narrow this.
server.buttonLabel: StoreNotificationRequest rules() `data.button_label` => nullable|string|max:26, which Laravel counts in code points (mb_strlen).
